description: The max_path_len field is documented as 'Maximum chain depth, not counting the trust anchor.' and the example says '[leaf, intermediate, root] is depth 1 (one intermediate)'. RFC 5280 §6.1.2 defines 'max_path_length' as the number of certs in the path including the EE but excluding the anchor (which is the same count as our intermediates+1). The docs should explicitly note this difference from the RFC variable name and semantics, so a security reviewer comparing the implementation against RFC 5280 §6.1.2 step (l) does not get confused or file a 'max_path_len is off by one' issue.
title: max_path_len docs diverge from RFC 5280 §6.1.2 without explanation
